answer: A state-attestation mechanism restricts Sybil identities across an ocean of decentralized nodes by auditing streaming data pipelines. Each agent embeds a verifiable cryptographic pigment into sequential state roots, continuously validated against a static marble reference. An attacker incurs ongoing costs in dedicated memory bandwidth and non-compressible storage per counterfeit persona. However, honest agents with constrained uplinks risk desynchronization and unwarranted eviction.
